source='''def transform(grid):
    """Complete the observed one-dimensional periodic diagonal color pattern."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    points = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    if not points:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    # The marks lie on parallel diagonals. Select the diagonal axis that groups
    # the most same-colored marks into complete observed stripes.
    choices = []
    for name, keyfn in (("difference", lambda r, c: c-r), ("sum", lambda r, c: r+c)):
        groups = {}
        for r, c, color in points:
            groups.setdefault(keyfn(r, c), {}).setdefault(color, 0)
            groups[keyfn(r, c)][color] += 1
        score = sum(n*(n-1)//2 for group in groups.values() for n in group.values())
        maxline = max((n for group in groups.values() for n in group.values()), default=0)
        choices.append((score, maxline, name, keyfn, groups))
    _, _, _, keyfn, groups = max(choices, key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1]))

    marks = {}
    for k, counts in groups.items():
        # A true stripe has one color; choose its most frequent color if a
        # crossing or stray mark creates a mixed diagonal.
        marks[k] = max(counts, key=counts.get)

    # Find the shortest repeating diagonal sequence consistent with all
    # observed colored stripes.
    span = max(abs(k) for k in marks) + 1
    period = next((p for p in range(1, max(span + 1, 2))
                   if all((a-b) % p != 0 or ca == cb
                          for a, ca in marks.items() for b, cb in marks.items())), span)
    pattern = {}
    for k, color in marks.items():
        pattern[k % period] = color

    # All residues are specified in these tasks. For an unseen residue, extend
    # from the nearest known residue rather than leaving a hole.
    known = sorted(pattern)
    out = []
    for r in range(h):
        row = []
        for c in range(w):
            residue = keyfn(r, c) % period
            if residue in pattern:
                color = pattern[residue]
            else:
                nearest = min(known, key=lambda q: min((residue-q) % period, (q-residue) % period))
                color = pattern[nearest]
            row.append(color)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
